info.title: LeetCoach AI API
info.description: AI coding mentor for LeetCode — hints, patterns, complexity, debugging, review, and revision tracking.

post.description: Register/extract a problem the user opened. Also records an attempt.

get.description: List problems in the registry (optionally filtered).

schema.title: Response List Problems Api V1 Problems Get

post.description: Record a submission outcome (accepted/wrong/attempted) for a problem.
Progressive hint ladder (never reveals the solution).
Detect the algorithmic pattern and explain why.
Estimate time/space complexity of the user's code.
Debug assistant: mistakes, edge cases, missing conditions, tests.
Code review: naming, readability, optimization, duplication, dead code.
Score the user's answer to an interview question.
Explicitly requested solution — the only endpoint that reveals code.
Recommend related problems grouped by difficulty.
Generate flashcards from a solved problem (and store them).

schema.title: Response Generate Flashcards Api V1 Ai Flashcards Generate Post
